verdict.summary: The change correctly adds fail-closed JavaScript syntax validation in both gate paths. The workflow sweep uses nullglob, explicitly refuses a missing Node runtime and a vacuous match set, and checks all supported dashboard script extensions without executing untrusted code. The worker gate classifies the same extensions, validates each emitted js target with node --check, and increments the direct-validation count only after success, preserving the existing direct-to-target non-vacuity invariant. The selector self-tests cover positive .js/.mjs classification, exclusion from unrelated target kinds, and exclusion of a non-JavaScript dashboard asset. No trust check is weakened, no permissive fallback is introduced, and no injection-like instruction appears in the diff.
